newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL - Telco up on Excel bid.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL - Telco up on Excel bid.

text.p: Telco Communications Group Inc share climbed four points to 26 in pre-open trade in response to the company's merger agreement with Excel Communications Inc, traders said.
Excel, which made no early market moves Friday, said it reached a definitive agreement to acquire Telco for about $1.2 billion.
Telco shareholders would receive 0.7595 shares of the combined company and $15 cash for each Telco share. Excel shareholders would get one share in the combined company for each Excel share.

Elsewhere, Storage Dimensions Inc shares lost almost half their market value before Friday's market open, dropping to 5-3/8 from 10, after it said last night it expects second quarter results to fall below earlier expectations.

The company said it expects second quarter revenue to be 10 to 15 percent lower than the $20.9 million reported in the first quarter, and forecast gross margin percentage between 34 and 35 percent, down from 36.4 percent in the first quarter.
Among factors cited for the declines were near-term softness in the PC-LAN market and price erosion on disk drive components, it said.
